<style>
  .slides-frame { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 75vh; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px; }
  .slides-frame p { margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%; }
  .slides-frame iframe { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; display: block; border-radius: 6px; }
  .fs-toggle { position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 10px; z-index: 20;
    background: #17251F; color: #F1EEE6; border: 0; border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; }
  .fs-toggle:hover { background: #2E7D6B; }
</style>

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
<div class="slides-frame" id="frame">
  <button class="fs-toggle" id="fs-btn" onclick="toggleFullscreen()">Fullscreen</button>
  <iframe id="slides" src="session-2.html" title="Explore your data: the tidyverse" style="width:100%; height:75vh; border:0; display:block" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</div>
:::

<script>
  function toggleFullscreen() {
    var frame = document.getElementById('slides');
    var btn = document.getElementById('fs-btn');
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
      var p = frame.requestFullscreen ? frame.requestFullscreen() :
              frame.webkitRequestFullscreen ? frame.webkitRequestFullscreen() : null;
      if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function(){});
      btn.textContent = 'Exit fullscreen (Esc)';
    } else {
      var d = document.exitFullscreen ? document.exitFullscreen() :
              document.webkitExitFullscreen ? document.webkitExitFullscreen() : null;
      if (d && d.catch) d.catch(function(){});
      btn.textContent = 'Fullscreen';
    }
  }
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', function () {
    document.getElementById('fs-btn').textContent =
      document.fullscreenElement ? 'Exit fullscreen (Esc)' : 'Fullscreen';
  });
</script>

The deck is embedded above; the site navigation and sidebar stay visible. Click inside
the deck to focus it, then use the **arrow keys** to move between slides. Use the
**Fullscreen** button to view without the surrounding chrome; press **Esc** to return.
